items.name: surfaces
items.title: Semantic Design Tokens
items.description: Complete semantic token system: color, typography, control sizes, radii, shadows, surfaces, and layers. Ordinary layout spacing uses Tailwind's native scale. The historical surfaces slug is retained for compatibility.

dark.shadow-floating: inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--dm-hi-mid), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--dm-ring-base), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.12), 0 1px 1px -0.5px var(--dm-drop), 0 3px 3px -1.5px var(--dm-drop)
dark.shadow-overlay: inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--dm-hi-high), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--dm-ring-mid), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.16), 0 1px 1px -0.5px var(--dm-drop), 0 3px 3px -1.5px var(--dm-drop), 0 6px 6px -3px var(--dm-drop), 0 12px 12px -6px var(--dm-drop)

items.name: utils
items.title: Utilities
items.description: Utility function for merging Tailwind CSS classes with clsx and tailwind-merge.

items.name: springs
items.title: Spring Animations
items.description: Spring animation token presets for Framer Motion (fast, moderate, slow).

items.name: surface-context
items.title: Surface Context
items.description: React context that carries the current semantic substrate role through nested and portaled content.

items.name: surface-classes
items.title: Surface Class Lookup
items.description: Typed semantic Surface and Shadow class maps with role-based nesting resolution.

items.name: elevated
items.title: Elevated
items.description: Semantic elevation primitive that resolves a Surface role, applies an independent Shadow role, and re-provides the substrate to descendants.

items.name: shape-context
items.title: Shape Context
items.description: React context provider for runtime shape variant switching (pill or rounded). Controls border-radius across all Zeron Design components.

items.name: icon-context
items.title: Icon Context
items.description: Named icon slots with a HugeIcons default set; swap any icon via IconProvider.

items.name: pro-icon-provider
items.title: HugeIcons Pro Variants
items.description: Optional HugeIcons Pro provider with Stroke Standard, Bulk Rounded, and Duotone Rounded variants. Requires a HugeIcons Pro license and private npm registry access.

items.name: use-proximity-hover
items.title: useProximityHover
items.description: React hook for proximity-based hover detection. Tracks the closest item to the mouse cursor within a container, enabling smooth animated background indicators.

items.name: use-touch-primary
items.title: useTouchPrimary
items.description: Detects touch-primary devices (coarse pointer + touch points), updating live on pointer-mode and media-query changes. Adapted from Lina (https://lina.sameer.sh).

items.name: use-merge-split
items.title: useMergeSplitBlocks
items.description: React hook + renderer for the selected-background merge/split animation. When one row bridges or splits two contiguous selected runs, their inner edges glide together (or apart) and swap to a single block, instead of one block spring-growing over the union.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion (Base UI)
items.description: Collapsible accordion with animated height transitions, spring-animated chevron, and proximity hover in grouped mode. Base UI flavor.

items.name: ask-user-questions
items.title: Ask User Questions
items.description: Stepped question flow with numbered options, keyboard shortcuts (1–9), single or multi-select, inline 'other' text input, optional skip, proximity-based hover, and multi-question navigation. Auto-advances on selection in single-select.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Compact label with solid and dot variants, Tailwind color palette, and three sizes.

items.name: badge-overflow
items.title: Badge Overflow
items.description: Responsive badge list that measures available space, wraps to a configurable line count, and replaces hidden items with an overflow count.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Composable breadcrumb navigation with links, current-page state, custom separators, ellipsis, responsive wrapping, and polymorphic link rendering.

items.name: button
items.title: Button (Base UI)
items.description: Animated button with variants (primary, destructive, secondary, tertiary, ghost), icon support, and loading spinner. Base UI flavor.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Feature-rich TanStack data table with sorting, text and faceted filters, pagination, row selection, column visibility, pinning, and empty/action states.

items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data Grid
items.description: Virtualized spreadsheet-style data grid with inline editors, range selection, copy and paste, search, sorting, resizing, and pinned columns.

items.name: dropdown
items.title: Dropdown
items.description: Dropdown menu with proximity hover, animated selection indicator, inline panel or triggered popup with collision-aware positioning, typeahead, and close-on-select. Includes MenuItem. Base UI flavor.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox (Base UI)
items.description: Compact animated checkbox with checked, indeterminate, disabled, validation, and form states. Base UI flavor.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox Group (Base UI)
items.description: Animated checkbox group with proximity hover, contiguous selection merging, and spring-animated check marks. Base UI flavor.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover (Base UI)
items.description: Accessible collision-aware popover with click or hover triggers, semantic floating surfaces, and an optional liquid anchor-to-panel transition.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group (Base UI)
items.description: Composable radio group with an atomic RadioGroupItem, form support, and enhanced proximity-hover RadioItem rows. Base UI flavor.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog (Base UI)
items.description: Animated modal dialog with spring-based scale and opacity transitions. Base UI flavor.

items.name: mobile-drawer
items.title: Mobile Drawer
items.description: Slide-in navigation drawer with scrim, focus trap, and scroll lock. Base UI flavor.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text input with outline, secondary, and ghost variants, four sizes, and accessible focus, validation, disabled, and file states.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Compact keycaps and shortcut groups for keyboard commands and interaction hints.

items.name: input-copy
items.title: Input Copy
items.description: Read-only input with a copy-to-clipboard button and animated check feedback. Supports optional label and shape context.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Composable input surface with inline or stacked addons, compact actions, text inputs, textareas, and validation states. Includes the legacy InputFieldGroup for multi-field forms.

items.name: input-message
items.title: Input Message
items.description: Chat-style message composer with auto-resizing textarea, drag-and-drop file attachments (PNG / JPEG / PDF), flexible left/right action slots, and a built-in send button on a Surface-2 substrate.

items.name: file-thumbnail
items.title: File Thumbnail
items.description: Read-only square preview of a File. Images render via object-cover; PDFs render their first page via pdfjs; a spinner shows while either resolves. Adapts its corner radius to the global shape setting.

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Chat Message
items.description: A single chat transcript entry with baked-in entrance and layout motion. Right-aligned accent bubble for the user, left-aligned muted bubble for the assistant, with optional file attachments. Adapts to the global shape setting.

items.name: tabs-subtle
items.title: TabsSubtle (legacy)
items.description: Compatibility adapter for Tabs' segment variant. New integrations should use Tabs with variant="segment".

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch (Base UI)
items.description: Animated toggle switch with spring-based thumb animation. Base UI flavor.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Animated table with proximity-based row hover highlighting and fluid border transitions. Includes TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, and TableCell sub-components.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: shadcn's compositional card (Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, CardFooter) with the Zeron Design layer: transparent substrate, weight-animated title, media/logo/feature/image slots, and a CardGroup that owns stacked, inline, and grid layouts plus 2-D proximity-hover highlighting.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider (Base UI)
items.description: Animated slider with spring-snapped thumb, step dots, range mode, and click-to-edit value display. Base UI flavor.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper (Base UI)
items.description: Accessible multi-step navigation with controlled and uncontrolled state, horizontal and vertical layouts, keyboard navigation, async validation, completion states, and previous/next controls.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs (Base UI)
items.description: Pill, segment, and underline tab navigation with animated selection indicators, proximity hover, and spring animations. Base UI flavor.

items.name: thinking-indicator
items.title: Thinking Indicator
items.description: Animated loading indicator with morphing SVG path (circle to infinity loop) and shimmer text rotation. Cycles through customizable status words.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area (Base UI)
items.description: Scroll container with a restyled overlay scrollbar that stays discoverable on hover and follows the shape system. Falls back to native overflow scrolling on touch-primary devices. Base UI flavor; adapted from Lina (https://lina.sameer.sh).

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Animated select menu with collision-aware positioning, typeahead, proximity hover, spring-animated popover, and animated checkmark. Base UI flavor.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip (Base UI)
items.description: Floating tooltip with spring-based animations, configurable placement, and rich content support. Base UI flavor.

items.name: thinking-steps
items.title: Thinking Steps
items.description: Collapsible AI reasoning steps with animated expand/collapse, per-step icons, sources, and nested details. Base UI flavor.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: Color picker with HEX, RGB, HSL, and OKLCH formats, alpha channel, optional swatches, and a popover trigger. Built on Base UI's Popover, Menu, and NumberField primitives with native EyeDropper support.
